code: body { background: linear-gradient(270deg, #1a0b2e, #4a1532, #0d122b, #2e0b1a); background-size: 800% 800%; animation: MorphogenicFluid 12s ease infinite; } * { border-radius: 25px !important; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.02) !important; box-shadow: none !important; } @keyframes MorphogenicFluid { 0%{background-position:0% 50%} 50%{background-position:100% 50%} 100%{background-position:0% 50%} } .viscous-plenum-container { backdrop-filter: blur(15px); }

body { animation: twilightPulse 4s infinite alternate ease-in-out !important; } @keyframes twilightPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(26, 0, 51, 0.8); background-color: #0a001a; } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(75, 0, 130, 0.9); background-color: #1a0033; } } .chat-message.ai { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.5); }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #000b18 0%, #000000 100%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } body::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.05) 10px, rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.05) 12px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.05) 10px, rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.05) 12px); animation: phaseShift 8s linear infinite; z-index: -1; } body::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(0, 255, 150, 0.1); border-radius: 50%; animation: plasmaJacket 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes phaseShift { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.05); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); } } @keyframes plasmaJacket { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(0, 255, 150, 0.05), 0 0 20px rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.1); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 200px rgba(0, 255, 150, 0.15), 0 0 50px rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.2); } } * { text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.4); }
